name: Create an action related to an incident
description: Create an action related to an incident (EZV_CreateRelatedAction)

action_type_id.description: Action type ID (tenant-specific); provide at least one of action_type_id, action_type_name or action_type_guid
action_type_id.title: Action Type Id

action_type_name.description: Action type name, in the REST API user language; provide at least one of action_type_id, action_type_name or action_type_guid
action_type_name.title: Action Type Name

action_type_guid.description: Action type GUID (EV SM 2023.4+); provide at least one of action_type_id, action_type_name or action_type_guid; if the API rejects the GUID, use an ID or name allowed for the ticket catalog
action_type_guid.title: Action Type Guid

group_id.description: Assigned group ID; provide at least one of group_id, group_name or group_mail
group_id.title: Group Id

group_name.description: Assigned group name; provide at least one of group_id, group_name or group_mail
group_name.title: Group Name

group_mail.description: Assigned group email; provide at least one of group_id, group_name or group_mail
group_mail.title: Group Mail

action.title: RelatedActionItem
action.description: Action to create; provide one action type and one group

success.description: Always true when returned; on failure the action fails and returns nothing

href.description: Ticket URL (HREF); only when present in the response
